commentary_segments.text: Before this oscillator is designed, we have to review the oscillation conditions. After this we will have a look at what the electrical model is of such a crystal. It can now be used to construct a single-transistor oscillator with minimum power consumption. Both MOST and bipolar transistors can be used to realize this kind of oscillator. Finally, the principles of oscillation can be extended to construct other types of oscillators, such as VCO’s, etc.
